decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-14 INTRODUCE that fully records the fresh-originality requirement and the AI draft's inspiration-only role.
The source modification to concept originality and reference-material role does not alter the candidate's colour direction, which is independently established by the same message.
The concept-originality modification does not change the independently established company name, excluded word, or wider-business representation.
The source explicitly leaves the existing strapline unchanged, so the candidate remains valid without modification.
Treating the AI draft as inspiration and requiring original concepts does not change the separate obligation to supply brand-colour documentation.
The source decision about concept originality and reference material has no necessary effect on the separate font-guidance deliverable.
